name: Aegis of Dawn
note: Hand-captured from the official notes on release day. New hero Scarlett (Energy-based offlaner) is not in the omeda catalog yet; her card gets no showcase image or popup until the next snapshot.
global: Daybreak v7: Shrines are a new mini-objective (spawn 2:00, respawn 4:00, 3,100 HP) granting +2 permanent ability haste, 50 global gold, and up to two stacks of +8% true damage to towers.
Teleporters unlock at game start (was 8:00) with shorter cooldowns (120s early / 90s late) — cross-map pressure starts immediately.
Tower platings never expire (was 13:00), Tier 2 towers gain 4 platings of their own, and Tier 2 local gold falls 400 -> 250 — plating gold is the new tower economy.

Jungle economy rework: camp gold up across the board (Red/Blue 125 -> 165, large camps ~+40%), out-of-combat regen doubled (no more chip-clearing), CS values rebalanced, and duo/off lanes each gain a second Gold/Cyan buff at roughly half value.
Recall 8s -> 7s, DoTs no longer interrupt recalls, death timers ramp later (30:00), fountain no longer one-shots divers (ticking true damage instead).

tldr.lead: A new objective changes every rotation
tldr.text: Shrines grant permanent ability haste, global gold, and true damage to towers — the mini-objective war starts at 2:00 and never stops.
Nearly every carry lost 2-4 base physical power with growth compensation: early lane damage is down across the board, scaling is intact. Lane bullies and all-in supports gain relative early power.
A melee Energy-resource duelist with a restraining-stun ultimate and three augment paths (mobility, dueling, zone control).

tldr.lead: Tower sieging is a plating economy now
tldr.text: Platings never expire and Tier 2 towers get their own — chip damage and Shrine true-damage stacks beat one big dive.

tldr.lead: The jungle pays more and punishes more
tldr.text: Camp gold up ~35-40%, regen doubled between clears, and post-20:00 Red/Blue drop a second pickup buff. Junglers snowball harder; chip-clearing is dead.

tldr.lead: Four new Eternals and a new minor blessing
tldr.text: Weald (execute projectiles), Rust (stacking shred), Pilow (damage-output debuff) and Satariel (takedown power at a health cost) join the pool, and Mechadrive — a minor blessing, not an Eternal — replaces the deleted Cauterize. That is five cards marked new in the Eternals section below.
Potions down another notch, Marrow reworked to missing-health scaling, Immaculate and healing minors shaved — the sustain squeeze from 1.15.3 continues.

systems.name: Shrines (new mini-objective)
systems.summary: Spawn 2:00, respawn 4:00, 3,100 HP. Killer gains +2 ability haste permanently, 50 global gold, and +8% true damage to towers (max 2 stacks).

systems.name: Daybreak v7
systems.summary: Teleporters open at 0:00 (120s/90s cooldowns), WorldShift/Shaper/Seedling removed, second Gold buff in duo lane and second Cyan in offlane at ~half value, homeguard jump-pad speed, movement -15 vs Sanctuary.

systems.name: Tower platings
systems.summary: Tier 1 platings permanent (gold 70 -> 60 each); Tier 2 towers gain 4 permanent platings (50g each) with local kill gold 400 -> 250.

systems.name: Jungle economy
systems.summary: Camp gold up across the board (Red/Blue 125 -> 165 with 6 CS), out-of-combat regen doubled, camps despawn 10s after leader dies, Mini Prime and post-20:00 Red/Blue drop floor buffs; Energy regen added to buffs for Scarlett.

systems.name: Fountain & recalls
systems.summary: Fountain deals ramping true damage instead of one-shotting; recall 7s and immune to DoT interruption; ground targeting now from camera reticle.

systems.name: Brawl mode returns
systems.summary: Ticket-based ruleset overhaul: hero kills -8 tickets, lane Fangtooth portal -25, giant buffs, starting level 3 with 1,400 gold.

eternals.summary: Four new Eternals join the pool (Weald, Rust, Pilow, Satariel) and Mechadrive, a new minor blessing, replaces the deleted Cauterize. Marrow is reworked to missing-health healing, and the sustain/economy minors all take a trim.

changes.name: Weald
changes.change: NEW — major fires true-damage projectiles at enemies below 30% health.
changes.meaning: An execute Eternal: finishes low targets through armor. Expect it on burst divers and anyone who struggles to close kills.

changes.name: Rust
changes.change: NEW — major applies stacking armor shred that amplifies damage taken.
changes.meaning: A team-amplifier for sustained hitters: the longer a target is worked, the softer it gets for everyone.

changes.name: Pilow
changes.change: NEW — major pulses a debuff reducing enemy damage output.
changes.meaning: A defensive team Eternal — front-liners and supports can now itemize enemy damage down instead of only their own health up.

changes.name: Satariel
changes.change: NEW — major grants stacking power from takedowns while reducing max health.
changes.meaning: A snowball gamble: every takedown makes the carrier hit harder and die easier. Strong ahead, throwing fuel behind.

changes.name: Mechadrive
changes.change: NEW (replaces Cauterize) — basic attacks refund 10% of the Secondary ability cooldown on-hit (5% vs non-heroes).
changes.meaning: An attack-weaving reward for hybrid kits; Cauterize owners need a new pick.

changes.name: Marrow
changes.change: Reworked: heal 6-9% of hero damage, scaling up to 15-30% based on missing health (65% for AoE, 15% vs monsters).
changes.meaning: Lifesteal that arrives when low instead of always-on — stronger in losing fights, weaker for stat-checking at full HP.

changes.name: Roses
changes.change: Bonus takedown gold capped at +100g (5 takedowns); hero kills grant +50% of Marrow major for 8s.
changes.meaning: The gold engine gets a ceiling but adds a post-kill sustain window.

changes.name: Ferocity
changes.meaning: A straight trim to the attack-speed minor most carries defaulted to.

changes.name: The King
changes.meaning: Slightly slower gold curve for on-hit builds.

changes.name: Nihil
changes.change: Stat effectiveness per takedown or level 18% -> 20%.
changes.meaning: The scaling minor closes more of the gap.

changes.name: Feeding Frenzy
changes.meaning: The cleanup radius shrinks — kills must be closer to feed it.

changes.name: Immaculate
changes.meaning: Second consecutive trim — the defensive window keeps shrinking.

changes.name: Masterpiece
changes.meaning: A small shave on the takedown-scaling damage minor.

changes.name: Aion
changes.meaning: The mage economy minor pays a little less, on top of its 1.15.3 power trim.

changes.name: Sacrifice
changes.change: Ability hits grant 2.5% missing-mana regen over 5s; hero kills regenerate 20% missing mana over 5s.
changes.meaning: Mana sustain now flows from aggression instead of passively.

changes: Daybreak Invitational Tournament runs Saturday 15th & Sunday 16th.
Brawl mode returns as a separate queue with a reworked ticket ruleset.

NEW HERO — melee offlane duelist running Energy instead of mana. Kit: Last Light (Energy passive), Ashen Vow, First Intent (dash), Minueta (multi-stab), Swan Song (restraining-stun ultimate with blade ignition). Three augments: Scarlet Dawn (mobility), Coup De Grace (dueling), Volcanic Slam (zone control).
Mana Catalyst no longer restores mana on non-heroes (heroes 10% -> 12%)
Falcon Crunch empowered damage 15% -> 20%, in-air cooldown +30% -> +25%
Physical power 60 -> 57, growth 3.6 -> 3.8 (early flattened, scaling intact)
Tesla Dome now correctly shreds magical armor (bugfix)
Make Way now correctly shreds magical armor (bugfix)
Badlands Critter double-damage bugfix (damage down in practice)
Cascade reworked — no longer applies on-hit effects
